name: trash
description: A straight-sided waste bin with rounded base corners, an open handle and two internal slots.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner requested the accepted X=105%, Y=95% proportions to become native source geometry, with Lab X/Y reset to100%/100%. The original Outline centerlines are baked about12,12: x maps to12+1.05*(x-12), y maps to12+.95*(y-12). Regular1.70 stroke and round .85 caps stay fixed. Base centerline corners become ellipses rx3.4125/ry3.0875; fitted handle corners become rx1.05/ry.95. Straight sides remain vertical. Filled is reconstructed from the baked Outline with an exact .85 normal offset, represented by tangent-continuous cubic segments at ellipse corners; no runtime transform or extra box is used. This keeps the styles aligned at native Regular1.70 rather than scaling the stroke weight. Native visible bounds in both styles are x=2.75..21.25 and y=2.4575..21.5425, width18.5/height19.085. The original 2px top/bottom native-margin reference is superseded by the owner-approved baked proportion adjustment. Slots share x9.9/14.1, y10.1..16.75 with .85 round caps. Owner-approved proportions; native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Established centerline proportions and pose are retained. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75. Owner slot-length revision: shorten each slot by1px at both ends, retaining x9.9/14.1 and the same center y13.425. New centerlines y11.1..15.75, length4.65; Regular visible/cutout bounds y10.225..16.625 with radius.875 caps. Body, lid, handle, baked105/95 proportions and1.75 weight remain unchanged.

review.note: Owner requested shorter internal slots. Previous approval and baked proportions are retained in history; revised slot length awaits owner review.

reviewHistory.note: Owner approved the original Trash at X105%/Y95%, then explicitly requested baking those proportions into native source and returning Lab controls to100%/100%. Preserve Regular1.70 and the fitted handle/base contours. Both styles remain approved.
